kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Mixed panes (US-FP-004 sc. 3; §4.3 L276-278): three docked BTCUSDT panels: Box grid on 5m (left), Profile histogram on 5m (middle), the same grid on Volume 50 BTC bars under E12-D02's "Bar order · not time" (right). Trigger: Alt+F in the middle pane toggled it from box to profile; each pane keeps its own display (§6.2 L509). Also via the legend's ⋯, SCR-042 and SCR-032 (§4.9 L382-387; §6.1 L450).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: The footprint is market data (§5 L408): every role sees these cells and may toggle the display, which applies instantly (§6.2 L509); without workspaces:write it lasts for this session only (§6.5 L622). Drawn for the owner's session: nothing here is gated (no T2).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Alt+F (chart.footprint_mode) toggles box and profile in the focused pane (§4.3 L278), a global key the plot does not consume; with the footprint off it changes nothing and says "Footprint is off." (PROPOSED state key, §4.9 L387-388) once (§8.1 L738). F toggles [FP] (§4.9 L377). Tab per chart panel: toolbar → status chips → strip actions; per pane: legend and its ⋯ → plot → …; then time axis → cluster (§8.1 L721-724). SCR-037's Alt+F yields (§4.9 L388).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: The middle pane's plot stop: CMP-039's ring at the plot's edge and D10's cursor column on 13:35 (E11-D02 §12 L658; E06-D03 D10), where Alt+F acted; other panes unchanged.

kids.name: value-1
